worldcombat.skill.highjumpkick.summary: A heavy skyward knee: spring almost straight up, hang at the apex to show the landing point, then drive the knee down into it. A hit is the heaviest contact damage in the family; a miss cracks the whole leg on the ground, hurting the user the most.
worldcombat.skill.highjumpkick.descripti: The falling knee deals about %1$s contact damage; the target's defence, type match-up and crits are settled on the hit.
Rise %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick, dive at %3$s blocks per tick with %4$s blocks per tick of forward drift.

Leaps in from up to %1$s blocks away and drives the knee into the landing spot with a %2$s-block hit radius; if no enemy is near the landing spot the kick misses and the user takes %3$s of its own maximum health as self-damage.

While rising, the landing point tracks the target; at the apex it locks and hangs for %1$s ticks, showing the foe where the knee will come down - which is also its window to move away. The knee lands on the first enemy met in the dive or the nearest one by the landing spot, shoving it up to %2$s blocks along the dive.
Vertical knee: a higher toss, x1.08 knee power, a faster dive and +0.06 self-hurt, at +2 ticks of wind-up, +8 ticks of cooldown, 1 block less reach and a longer apex hang (easier to dodge).
Diagonal knee: farther, faster and lighter, at the cost of a tier less knee power and falling momentum.
worldcombat.skill.highjumpkick.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP; cooldown %5$s s from commitment.
worldcombat.skill.highjumpkick.growth.0: From level %1$s the knee power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.highjumpkick.growth.1: From level %1$s the knee power rises to %2$s and the leap height to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.highjumpkick.use.0: Punch through a hard target with the heaviest contact hit of the family
worldcombat.skill.highjumpkick.use.1: Pressure a target in your face from above
worldcombat.skill.highjumpkick.use.2: Trade one aerial leap for knockback and position
worldcombat.skill.highjumpkick.preferenc: On: near-vertical toss and drop, x1.08 knee power, faster dive, +0.06 self-hurt, at +2 ticks of wind-up, +8 ticks of cooldown, 1 block less reach and a longer apex hang (easier to dodge). Off: diagonal knee, farther, faster and lighter.
Only knee a target within this distance; closer in otherwise. Larger starts sooner, and lands behind a moving target more often.
Below this health ratio the user stops using High Jump Kick (a miss's self-hurt can be lethal). Higher is more cautious; lower takes more risk.
